plan.notes: University of Denver is on the quarter system (Fall/Winter/Spring); term_system=quarter. Official sample 4-year course plan from the 2025-2026 Undergraduate Bulletin Economics program PDF (12 quarters). Plan states Total Credits: 190; declared total 190. Generic slots (language/SI sequences, AI/SI Society, Common Curriculum-style Ways of Knowing, upper-division ECON electives, study-abroad blocks, second major/minor/electives) encoded as choice slots exactly as the official plan lists them; no courses invented. ECON 3990 Capstone (2 credits) is listed in both Fall and Spring of fourth year with footnote 2 ('If not completed in fall of fourth year'). Both placements carry the bulletin's printed 2 credits, matching the bulletin's own term totals (Year 4: Fall 14, Winter 16, Spring 14) and the bulletin's declared Total Credits: 190; the credit sum here reconciles to 190. In practice a student completes it once; the footnote's alternative placement is documented in the Spring choice_note. INTZ 2501 (footnote 1) required only for students who study abroad.
